sentences.text: Keep your pencil sharp, because a thick line on a coast chart can hide a tenth of a mile.
Label every line and position as you draw it, so you can find your work again in a multi-part problem.
Work in true directions and convert to magnetic or compass only at the end.
Exam answers are usually to the nearest degree and the nearest tenth of a mile, with choices close together.
If your answer doesn’t match any choice, go back and find the step that went wrong rather than guessing.
